description: This Java class defines configuration properties related to device connections in the Hono device registry, specifically setting and retrieving the maximum number of devices per tenant.

classes.name: MapBasedDeviceConnectionsConfigProperties
classes.description: Configuration properties for Hono's device connection API as own server. Manages the maximum number of devices per tenant, with getter and setter methods.

methods.name: getMaxDevicesPerTenant
methods.description: Returns the maximum number of devices per tenant for which connection data is stored.

methods.name: setMaxDevicesPerTenant
methods.description: Sets the maximum number of devices per tenant; throws IllegalArgumentException if the value is less than or equal to zero.
